summary: Oruka Therapeutics, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten public offering of 9,660,000 shares of common stock at $72.50 per share, plus a 30-day option for up to 1,449,000 additional shares. The offering price reflects a ~2.0% discount to the last sale price of $73.99. Gross proceeds are ~$700M before underwriting discounts of $42M. Underwriters include Leerink Partners, TD Cowen, Goldman Sachs, Stifel, Guggenheim, and LifeSci Capital. This is a routine follow-on offering and does not constitute a special situation like a restructuring, going-private, or strategic review. No event-driven or structural change is indicated. What to watch: aftermarket share price relative to the offering price for trading dynamics.
